screenshots.en: A new puzzle around every corner

en.name: Anglepop
en.description: Pick your starting point. Find your angle. Clear every block with a single, satisfying shot.
en.screenshotNote: Actual in-app screenshots, shown in Simplified Chinese. Anglepop also supports English.

zh.name: Anglepop
zh.description: 自由选起点，找到合适的角度。让小球沿着反弹路线，一次发射，清除全部目标。
zh.screenshotNote: 实际 App 截图，展示简体中文界面。Anglepop 同时支持英文。

screenshots.en: A habit that fits your day
screenshots.zh: 设定适合自己的打卡规则

screenshots.en: Your progress, on the Home Screen

screenshots.zh: 从这里，开始一个好习惯

en.name: CheckInDuck
en.description: Choose an app, set a daily goal, and let your usage count toward a check-in. Gentle reminders and a calendar help you keep going.
en.screenshotNote: Original in-app screenshots from CheckInDuck, shown in English.

zh.name: 打卡鸭
zh.tagline: 每天一点点，好习惯慢慢来。
zh.description: 选一个 App，定下每天的小目标。使用时长达标，就自动打卡；配合截止提醒和日历记录，让坚持轻松一点。
zh.screenshotNote: 来自打卡鸭原官网的实际 App 截图，展示英文界面。

screenshots.en: A learning path, one lesson at a time
screenshots.zh: 沿着课程路径，一点点学会
答错也没关系，图解告诉你为什么
从认牌开始，把基础弄明白
输入手牌，比较每一种打法
每天几道题，慢慢练出牌感

en.name: TileSense
en.tagline: Better hands. One tile at a time.
en.description: Learn mahjong step by step, from your first tiles to smarter discards. Short lessons, visual explanations and a hand analyzer help you understand each choice.
en.screenshotNote: Actual in-app screenshots, shown in Simplified Chinese. TileSense also supports English and Japanese.

zh.name: 牌感
zh.tagline: 每天几分钟，慢慢练出牌感。
zh.description: 从认识麻将牌，到理解每一次取舍。用短课、图解和每日练习学会牌效，再用手牌分析器比较下一张该打什么。
zh.screenshotNote: 来自牌感 App 的实际截图，展示简体中文界面。牌感同时支持英文和日文。
